tier: full (drawing document fields + public API): two audit rounds with mutation, actual run
before: measured 2026-10-31: point datum targets only (X at a straight-edge endpoint, split symbol with an empty upper half), no kind field, one generic refusal

change.fields: datum target kind 'line' {line: {from, to}} and 'area' {area: circle {at, d} | rect {at, w, h}} (view mm points, model mm sizes); moveable on points; canonical key order in readDatumTargets (authored == reopened JSON); numbers 1..99 and unique letter+number at authoring
change.drawing: ASME Y14.5: area = phantom outline (model size × view scale) with 45° hatching at 1 mm clipped to it, leader ending at a dot; line = one phantom line in the direct view (no X; X stays for points); symbol = split circle with the area size (Ø6 / 6×4) above and the letter+number below; moveable = the circle drawn out to a point by two tangent lines, the point away from the leader; new phantom pen; DXF PHANTOM layer/linetype only when used; 3D annotation data carries kind, area and moveable
change.checks: DATUM_TARGET_OUTSIDE warns when a line end or any part of an area lies outside the view's projected part box; DATUM_UNDEFINED counts line/area letters; refusals name the row; chat schema per kind (oneOf, min/max) and the chat validator gained const/not/oneOf/minimum/maximum without false double matches
change.studio: Datum targets: Kind (Point/Line/Area), area shape and size, Add then clicks in a view (line: two ends; area: centre) then the symbol; moveable under Details; Kind change cancels a pending pick; legacy rows say in words why moveable cannot change

audits.round1: CHANGES_REQUIRED: medium — line/area targets never went stale; medium — moveable symbol not the ASME form; low-medium — line target mixed ASME/ISO; low — schema looser than the checker, test gaps, Studio pending pick on Kind change. 21/28 mutants caught
audits.round2: targeted: all fixes verified (84 leader angles for the moveable symbol), mutants caught; one regression — the validator ignored const so set_drawing's scope oneOf refused valid scopes — fixed and verified by the root

actualRun.run04: final source PASS on bracket.bcad: Datum targets → Area, Circle, Ø4, Add, click the centre (15, 3) in the front view, place the symbol; Line, Add, click the top edge ends (0, 6) and (30, 6), place the symbol; Undo/Redo; Save + fresh Open equal; Export SVG → oracle: stored area Ø4 at the clicked centre and line between the clicked ends; phantom area outline with every hatch line inside it; phantom target line with no X marks; split symbols with Ø4 above A1, A2 alone; 0 page/console errors; root reviewed a zoomed render of the exported targets
failedRuns: run01: oracle read the symbol circle's start point as its left point (it is the right-most); product fine

followUps: DATUM_TARGET_OUTSIDE uses the view's projected box, not its silhouette (a target in a hole or notch is not warned)
